errors.evidence: The bar representing the statutory minimum wage ('Gesetzlicher Mindestlohn') is light blue, not light purple ('hellviolett'). The legend clearly shows a light blue square for this category.

errors.text_span: Der gesetzliche Mindestlohn beträgt 2015 8,50 €, steigt dann auf 10,59 €, 10,82 €, 10,92 €, 9,19 €, 9,35 €, 12,00 €, 12,80 €, 13,12 €, 13,93 €, 14,69 € und schließlich 15,12 € im Jahr 2025.
errors.evidence: This sentence incorrectly lists values for the 'Gesetzlicher Mindestlohn'. While it correctly identifies the value for 2015 (8,50 €), most of the subsequent values listed (10,59; 10,82; 10,92; 12,80; 13,12; 13,93; 14,69; 15,12) actually belong to the other series ('60 % des Medianlohns'). The values for 'Gesetzlicher Mindestlohn' are almost entirely misrepresented.

errors.text_span: 60 % des Medianlohns von Vollzeitbeschäftigten beginnen bei 8,50 € im Jahr 2015
errors.evidence: The series for '60 % des Medianlohns' does not begin at 8,50 €. The chart shows its value in 2015 is 10,59 €. The value 8,50 € belongs to the other series, 'Gesetzlicher Mindestlohn'.

The values for '60 % des Medianlohns' do not end at 12,41 € and 12,82 €. These are the 2024 and 2025 values for the other series ('Gesetzlicher Mindestlohn'). The correct values for '60 % des Medianlohns' in 2024 and 2025 are 14,69 € and 15,12 €, respectively.

The description fails to mention the striped pattern on the purple bars for the years 2024 and 2025. This is a distinct visual feature that likely indicates that these are projected or estimated values.
The description for the '60 % des Medianlohns' series is extremely incomplete. It only mentions three values (all of which are incorrect) and omits the data for all the years between 2015 and 2024.
